reviews.title: Very bad experience
reviews.text: The status in app is ( in transit ) for 18 days. And it’s still not trackable . The app tells the order will reach in 9-13 days , this message was on the app for 14 days. I’ve got a message on whats app that the order was received the destination before 11 days . When I called the phone number  shared on whats app . They told me that the have stopped dealing with ChicPount

reviews.text: The delivery is always late and when I got the item it was small and tissue not good I sent the request for return 3 times every time its rejected for stupid reson one of them is they can not see the tissu quality from the picture I removed the app and I don’t recommend

reviews.title: To bad

reviews.title: Very Disappointing with service n quality
reviews.text: First the quality of product is bad and after they are not returning items.

reviews.title: Return process
reviews.text: I’m really disappointed with this online app. Returning items is a nightmare — the process is slow, and feels intentionally difficult. Customer service isn’t any better; responses take forever, and you don’t get clear help when you finally hear back. Overall, a very frustrating experience. I won’t be ordering again.
